posts.cooked:
I has been lurking here, but didn't post since I didn't want to meddle unwanted-ly in any in-group things. Also TBH I don't really know anybody well enough yet to target questions at specific people versus at the group at large. *sheepish look*

@UXM: It works out rather conveniently hero-side that my most fave heroes happen to also be the ones I like playing the most.

Unity I love for being an adorable, heroic, girly Robot Army Master and technopath. I'm a big techie and member of the Chicks Dig (Giant) Robots brigade and it's such an unusual and fun combination of character traits to boot. And who doesn't love going around smashing villains with said Robot Army, especially if you bring someone like her best pal Omni-X along to help her build all her robot buddies?

And I like the Argent Adept because I'm a singer who grew up in a music-steeped town so I've always had a fondness for music and playing bard characters in pretty much everything I can. (Albeit admittedly usually ones inspired more by Elan from Order of the Stick than Argent's serious personality, but...) Also I think this is the first time I've ever come across a bard superhero, which is unique in and of itself. Also also I think redheaded men are really cute. >_>;

And really how can you not have fun with the roughly five billion puzzley and complicated things Argent can pull off that often lead into everyone else getting to do even more things, combined with the digital game's awesome sound effects?

Fave villains are a bit more mismatched. I like Baron Blade and Spite thematically: I adore mad scientist characters (and rather like seeing Soviet Superscience getting play for a change versus Stupid Jetpack Nazis being more common to run into) and Spite is interestingly yet believably creepy and disturbing. (In fact I'd say he's the creepiest villain in the game because he's believable on a realism level... the drugs might be fantastic, but everything about him is all too realistic.) But Blade is sadly a little on the boring and easy side once you learn the game well (although his Vengeance self looks mighty interesting), and Spite of course is, well, Spite. So I prefer the puzzle-like mechanics of the Bloodsworn Arena and the minion-smashing melee of folks like Voss or La Capitain in terms of who to actually play against.

Uh, phew! Sorry if I talk too much...

[quote="Donner"]

@bobbertoriley Who is your least favorite Sentinels hero and why?  And if you say Setback, I'll cry. :_(

[/quote]

Hahaha, no. I love Setback. I don't play him as much as I do other heroes, but he's either in my top 5 or is honorable mention (depending on how lucky he is that day :) ).

So, looking through the pre-OblivAeon hero roster, there's only three that I don't particularly like to play. So, I'll go from more likely to play them to least likely to play.

  • Ra - There's nothing fundamentally wrong with Ra's deck as it is, but I just find playing him boring. My games with Ra usually end up with something along the lines of "How much fire do I need to respond to <X>?", and escalating from there. K.N.Y.F.E. and Haka are both examples to me of heroes that take a similar gimmick but make it more interesting by either adding consequence to your actions or making some of their cards more situational.
  • Visionary - This one mostly comes from a lack of playing her than anything else, but the strategy of playing her has yet to click with me. Her Ongoings are powerful and diverse and give her a lot of options, and her one-shots provide some good situational actions. However, I personally struggle to find when the right balance between when to set her up and when to use her one-shots. Also, I'd rather just play NightMist if I'm going to go down that route.
  • Expatriette - I want to love Expat, but her deck just doesn't work for me. Her power set has her over-relying on her guns (which makes sense thematically, but makes her very weak to equipment destruction), and her Ammo plays off as very weak, gimmicky one-shots. I've also found her prone to very bad draws. Support characters can make her much more playable, but if a support can make her okay, they could make a much better equipment-slinger (Wraith, Chrono Ranger) amazing in comparison. Expatriette is usually the only hero that I will re-roll when she comes up in random.

 

There's also a few heroes that I simply haven't played enough times to really say much about (The Sentinels, Sky-Scraper), but I hope to change that at some point.

(Man, them potentially some fighting words to fans of certain heroes around here. Disagree? Would love to hear your counter via PM or on the Sentinels boards)
